pluginContractFinding: The installed pi-legion-envoy (dogfood profile ~/.omp/profiles/legion, package 1.3.0) bundles the pre-change strictObject state contract; its controller/architect boot handshake calls daemon.state() first, so under this daemon the controller boots, never claims its role, and is retired/respawned every ~6 min (observed on the rig: 3 sessions, roles {}). Task 8's gate turns that into a named boot refusal.
